content.text:
________________________________________
From: Footer, Alyson <Alyson.Footer@mlb.com>
Sent: Friday, October 25, 2019 9:03 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: I’m sorry

Thanks Anthony. This means a lot to hear from you. You surely know first-hand how it is around here. It wasn’t an easy process but I got through it. Support from colleagues was amazing. I appreciate this!
I’ll be happy when 2019 is over too.

> On Oct 24, 2019, at 9:09 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
>
>  Hey, I just wanted to reach out and say I’m sorry about all this stuff. I cannot pretend to know how you feel, but I’d guess I know a little bit about the uncomfortable, hands-tied aftermath.
>
> Just know that - as I was reminded by people who I am so thankful for during those days - you are on the right side of history. And what you’re going through will help pave an easier road for other women in your shoes in the future.
>
> For as much as it is being broadcast otherwise, it is not lost on me who was really wronged in this situation.
>
> P.S. Don’t feel obligated to respond. I’m on vacation trying to forget about the 2019 season and it’s events, but I wanted to give you a shout.
>
> Anthony
>
>
>
>
>
>
>
> Anthony Fenech
> Detroit Free Press
> Tigers beat writer
> Twitter: @anthonyfenech
